sec: Phakomatosis/syndrome table and Carney's triad · p861

items.q: Match syndrome to gene — 1) Hyperparathyroidism/jaw tumour  2) Carney's complex  3) VHL  4) NF1  5) Cowden … A) Neurofibromin (Chr 17)  B) PTEN  C) Parafibromin (CDC73)  D) PRKAR1A  E) VHL gene (Chr 3)
items.exp: Parafibromin (CDC73), PRKAR1A, VHL (Chr 3), neurofibromin (Chr 17), PTEN respectively; McCune-Albright = post-zygotic GNAS (Gs α). (Book p861)

items.q: McCune-Albright syndrome differs from the others in inheritance because it is:
opts: Not inherited — post-zygotic GNAS (Gs α protein) mutation
items.exp: Not inherited; post-zygotic mutation of GNAS gene (Gs α protein). (Book p861)

items.q: The jaw neoplasia of hyperparathyroidism/jaw tumour syndrome and its endocrine tumour are:
opts: Ossifying fibroma of jaw; parathyroid Ca
items.exp: Ossifying fibroma of jaw with parathyroid carcinoma. (Book p861)

items.q: Carney's complex neoplasia and endocrine features are:
opts: Atrial myxoma (lepidic pattern); PPNAD (thin Cushing's), GH adenoma, rare prolactin tumour
items.exp: Atrial myxoma (lepidic pattern); endocrine PPNAD (thin Cushing's), GH-secreting adenoma, prolactin-secreting tumour (rare); skin lentigenes. (Book p861)

items.q: The VHL neoplasia list includes renal cell carcinoma, cerebellar haemangioblastoma, islet cell tumours and:
opts: Papillary cystadenoma of broad ligament, epididymal cyst, endolymphatic sac tumours
Optic nerve sheath tumour and meningioma
items.exp: VHL neoplasia: RCC, cerebellar haemangioblastoma, islet cell tumours, papillary cystadenoma of broad ligament of uterus, epididymal cyst, endolymphatic sac tumours; endocrine pheochromocytoma; additional pancreatic cysts. (Book p861)

items.q: NF1's neoplasia and endocrine association are:
opts: Optic nerve sheath tumour > meningioma; pheochromocytoma (U/L)
items.exp: NF1: optic nerve sheath tumour > meningioma; endocrine pheochromocytoma (unilateral). (Book p861)

items.q: Cowden syndrome (PTEN) neoplasia and thyroid features are:
opts: Ca breast and hamartomatous GIT polyps; nodular goitre or Hashimoto's thyroiditis
items.exp: Cowden: Ca breast, hamartomatous polyps of GIT; thyroid nodular goitre or Hashimoto's thyroiditis. (Book p861)

opts: Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia, precocious puberty, café-au-lait spots
items.exp: Triad: PFD, precocious puberty, café-au-lait spots; endocrine Cushing's, GH-secreting adenoma, precocious puberty. (Book p861)

items.q: Carney's TRIAD (distinct from Carney's complex) is:
items.exp: Carney's triad: pulmonary chondroma, GIST, paraganglioma. (Book p861)
